Seniors Adults

OPPORTUNITIES FOR EVERYONE

Seniors are involved in every facet of congregational life at Crosspoint, starting with Sunday worship but also including church leadership, small groups, women’s and men’s ministries, Outreach Team, Benevolence & Care Team, Prayer Team, Worship Team, and Children’s Ministries. We also help with putting on congregation-wide annual events such as the Fall Harvest Festival and the Christmas Toyshop. The LORD is on the move at Crosspoint, and we seniors are deeply connected and involved!

Tuesdays at 10:30 aM

Those who are 50-ish and older are encouraged to gather for fellowship and uplifting Bible study on Tuesday mornings at 10:30 at the church. Our next study concerning the Fruits of the Holy Spirit begins December 2nd. Contact our leader, retired pastor Russ Alden, for current information by texting 540-874-4442 or emailing russ_sandy@verizon.net.
